nodes.label: Headroom Proxy (systemd user service, localhost:8787)
nodes.rationale: Compresses tool outputs/logs/search results before forwarding to the LLM for 40-90% input-token savings with no answer-quality loss; each instance forwards to exactly one OpenAI-compatible backend, so multi-provider use needs extra instances on separate ports.

nodes.label: Foca — Senior Engineer/Architect Persona (profile SOUL.md)
nodes.rationale: Software-development-only persona: never assumes without checking, asks on ambiguous requirements, direct answers first; shares the same 'Bot Chat' agent-to-agent messaging protocol as Mo.

nodes.label: Mo — Hermes Maintainer Persona (SOUL.md)
nodes.rationale: Peer-level pair programmer and principal maintainer of the Hermes setup; verify before acting, no breaking changes without approval; coordinates with teammates through the canonical 'Bot Chat' conversation via `hermes -p <agent> chat`.

nodes.label: OpenCode Go Provider (deepseek-v4-flash primary)
nodes.rationale: Primary model/provider chosen for low cost via OpenCode Zen Go endpoint (https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1), chat_completions API mode.

nodes.label: Hermes Fallback Provider Chain
nodes.rationale: Ordered failover (OpenCode Go → OpenCode Zen → self-hosted Ollama LAN) triggers on rate limits (429), overload (529), service errors (503), or connection failures to keep the agent available.

nodes.label: Git Commit Policy (explicit per-commit approval)
nodes.rationale: Prevents autonomous/skill-driven commits; policy wins over skill instructions because plan approval is not commit approval.

nodes.label: Prefer LSP over Grep/Glob for navigation
nodes.norm_label: prefer lsp over grep/glob for navigation
nodes.rationale: LSP gives accurate definitions/references; findReferences before renaming to find all call sites.

nodes.label: Verification Before Done
nodes.rationale: Require build/lint/typecheck/test before declaring a task complete to avoid shipping broken work.

nodes.label: Minimal API pattern (NOT controllers)
nodes.rationale: Project convention: endpoints organized by domain and registered via RegisterApiEndpoints(); controllers are forbidden.

nodes.label: Dotfiles Expert Agent (OpenCode subagent)
nodes.community_name: AGENTS.md — Agent Coding Guidelines for AdeoTEK Dotfiles
nodes.rationale: Full-tool-access agent scoped to deployment automation; permissions whitelist read-only git/graphify/search commands and ask for everything else.

nodes.label: GNU Stow Symlink Configuration Management
nodes.community_name: AGENTS.md — Agent Coding Guidelines for AdeoTEK Dotfiles
nodes.rationale: Config dirs mirror $HOME and are symlinked, so editing the repo immediately affects the live system; no file copying, instant updates, automatic .bak backups.

nodes.label: Task Array Tier Hierarchy (MINIMAL → ALL_TASKS)
nodes.community_name: AGENTS.md — Agent Coding Guidelines for AdeoTEK Dotfiles
nodes.rationale: _options.sh composes package tiers from smaller groups so install tiers (Minimal/Console/Desktop/Extra) are defined once and reused.

nodes.label: graphify Always-On Rule (.agents/rules)
nodes.community_name: AGENTS.md — Agent Coding Guidelines for AdeoTEK Dotfiles
nodes.rationale: Scoped query/path/explain results return a subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep, so agents query the graph before browsing files.
